description: Use this when someone asks how buying, selling, renting or letting a home in Singapore works: grants and eligibility, BTO and resale, stamp duty, loans and down payments, the MOP, tenancy agreements, or renting out a flat or room. Also use it when a property agent asks how Homejourney works for agents: co-broking and CEA rules, verifying with Singpass, listing for clients, and viewing requests. Also use it when someone asks how to manage their Homejourney account: changing the sign-in email, resetting the password, verifying the email, or editing the profile. Returns Homejourney's reviewed guides and help articles that match, each with its URL, a short answer, who it is for (no persona means everyone), whether it has a calculator, and the date it was last checked. Cite the URL and its date. Filter with persona (buyer, seller, renter, landlord or agent); leave query empty to list every guide for that persona. Needs no sign-in.
name: search_guides

reviewedDate.description: When Homejourney last checked the guide.

resultReason.description: Why the search found no guide; absent when it found guides.

title: Search Homejourney guides
